hooks.command:
node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const base='src/routes/_index/components';if(!fs.existsSync(base))process.exit(0);const comps=fs.readdirSync(base,{withFileTypes:true}).filter(d=>d.isDirectory()).map(d=>d.name);let found=false;comps.forEach(c=>{const p=path.join(base,c,'pipeline-state.json');if(!fs.existsSync(p))return;try{const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));const ip=Object.entries(s.steps||{}).filter(([,v])=>v.status==='in-progress');if(ip.length){found=true;process.stdout.write('
⚠️  PIPELINE IN-PROGRESS — do not stop.
  Component: '+s.component+'
  Step '+ip.map(([k])=>k).join(', ')+' is still in-progress.
  Read pipeline-state.json and advance to the next step before stopping.
');}}catch(e){}});if(found)process.exit(2);" 2>/dev/null
